task: pick up the akita black bowl and place it on the plate in the left region
preprocessing: exact checkpoint preprocessor and postprocessor; no clipping added
finding: On eight real task-0 training frames, the 090000 checkpoint reproduces the demonstrated first action closely after the exact saved preprocessing/postprocessing path. This weakens the hypothesis that a global normalization or action-scale mismatch explains the 0/15 closed-loop result.
limitations: Open-loop first-action agreement does not prove long-horizon visual control or placement success
Only task 0 and eight contiguous frames were sampled

decision.recommended: an isolated training-side intervention or data/temporal objective audit, followed by a new checkpoint and calibrated strict evaluation
